name: Core CLI infrastructure (envelope, errors, config resolver)
description:
Build cli/src/lib/output.ts: the --json envelope (ok/schemaVersion/error/meta), structured errors, exit codes, and the message catalog (keys from the first string, default en, cs shipped; codes stay English forever).

Build cli/src/lib/config.ts: the three-scope config resolver per §5.7 — machine config (env-paths dir, mode 0600), committed project config (shoptet.config.json + shoptet.lock), gitignored derived cache (.shoptet/) — with precedence flags > env > project config > machine config > defaults. This is needed by auto-update immediately and by every later command, so it cannot be retrofitted.
